lede: Empowering our community one wave at a time.
mission:
Salinas Surf Club connects first responders, lifeguards, healthcare workers, and community surfers with at-risk youth in East Salinas, introducing them to the benefits of surfing, nature exploration, and environmental stewardship.

Our mission is to empower youth from low-income, diverse backgrounds by fostering water safety, physical activity, and community pride, while providing positive role models and leadership opportunities.

facts.title: Zero cost to families
facts.text: All students need to do is sign up. Everything is provided.

facts.title: Everything they need
facts.text: Surfboards, wetsuits, breakfast, snacks, and the ride to and from the beach.

facts.title: Run by volunteers
facts.text: First responders, lifeguards, healthcare workers, and community surfers.

facts.title: More than surfing
facts.text: Hiking and whale watching too, with overnight camping trips in the works.

day.title: The bus leaves Salinas
day.text: A school bus picks students up in East Salinas and brings them to the beach in Monterey.

day.title: Suit up
day.text: Volunteers hand out wetsuits and rash guards on the sand.

day.title: Warm up
day.text: Everyone stretches and practices popping up on the board before getting wet.

day.title: Into the water
day.text: Students pair up with volunteers, one-on-one or in small groups, and learn at their own pace.

day.title: Refuel
day.text: Breakfast and snacks on the beach.

donate_text: Donations cover surfboards, wetsuits, permits, and program costs, so the kids never pay a thing.
